note: On occupation he is the archetype the ICP quote describes — he runs his own company and the rep confirmed it off the application. Everything about his starting point fails the definition. Health is not a neglected corner of an otherwise good life; it is a stack of live problems, a compressed disc diagnosed three years ago, a knee that subluxes, and high blood pressure he is doing nothing about. That is nearer to rescue than to good-to-great, and he framed it that way himself: 'I want to just start with a new lifestyle, new mode. Maybe it has to change.' At 105 kg wanting 90 kg he is not 50 lb overweight, but the shape of the purchase is weight loss and repair rather than optimisation. Income could not be assessed at all — the recording is truncated at eighteen minutes and no financial discussion occurs — so it is recorded in neither list. Judged against the criteria as written, this is an edge case carried by occupation alone, and the criterion the ICP does not contain is the one that matters most here.
